first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The main person wearing a red-and-blue skintight suit with the head covered, swinging above the street between the buildings.

entities.name: Gray overcast sky
entities.identification: A cloudy-sky background behind the Cluster of city buildings, gray to blue-gray with soft variations in light and shade.

entities.name: Cluster of city buildings
entities.identification: Buildings with dark window bands on both sides of the street and in the distance, along with gray-brown and reddish-brown multistory buildings.

entities.name: City street
entities.identification: A gray road extending into the distance between the buildings, with curbs and intersections visible along it.

entities.name: Neighborhood trees
entities.identification: Groups of green and yellow-green tree crowns distributed on both sides of the road and in open spaces between the buildings.

entities.name: Street vehicles
entities.identification: A background group of cars on the City street, with light- and dark-colored body shapes visible, not split into separate identifiers.

entities.name: Thin line pulled by the person
entities.identification: A slender, linear interactive object above Person A and extending out of frame, with neither its material nor its off-screen anchor point specified.
